title: Auditable Unlearning for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.05866v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove a user's data from a trained model after a deletion request. Existing methods are majorly evaluated on three axes - how well they forget, how much capability they retain, and how robust they are to membership inference attacks, but not on whether the provider can offer the user any evidence that the deletion occurred. To fill this gap, we introduce auditability as a fourth axis, defined as the separation between requested (forget set) and retained (retain set) data under a statistic the provider computes. We show that across eleven unlearning methods on TOFU, MUSE and RWKU no method satisfies all four axes, with different methods falling short on different axes. translated_title: 可审计的大语言模型机器遗忘
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘旨在当用户提出删除请求后，将用户数据从已训练的模型中移除。现有方法主要从三个维度进行评估——遗忘效果如何、保留了多少模型能力，以及对成员推理攻击的鲁棒性——但并未评估服务提供者能否向用户提供删除确已发生的证据。为填补这一空白，我们引入可审计性作为第四个评估维度，定义为在提供者所计算的统计量下，被请求删除的数据（遗忘集）与保留数据（保留集）之间的分离程度。我们通过对 TOFU、MUSE 和 RWKU 数据集上十一种遗忘方法的评估发现，没有任何一种方法能同时满足全部四个维度，不同方法在不同维度上各有欠缺。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种可叠加于任何遗忘方法之上的两阶段方法：第一阶段我们提出 GapWiden，利用铰链损失来增大遗忘集与保留集审计统计量之间的差异……
tldr: 该论文首次将“可审计性”引入为机器遗忘的第四个评估维度，发现现有十一种方法无一能同时满足全部四个维度，并提出基于 GapWiden 的两阶段方法来扩大遗忘集与保留集的审计统计量差异，使删除操作可被验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces auditability as a fourth evaluation axis for machine unlearning, shows that none of eleven existing methods satisfies all four axes across TOFU, MUSE and RWKU, and proposes a two-stage method featuring GapWiden, which uses a hinge loss to widen the gap between audit statistics of the forget set and retain set to make deletion verifiable.
